references.title: DEBATE: Would God Allow Evil? @CosmicSkeptic vs @InspiringPhilosophy
references.descriptionOpening: In this live discussion, Alex O'Connor (Cosmic Skeptic) and Michael Jones (InspiringPhilosophy) discuss whether God would allow all of the evil and suffering in the world. Michael argues the answer is yes, while Alex argues no.

interpretation: The original Capturing Christianity livestream began June 13, 2020. The two named primary speakers debate divine permission of evil and suffering.
assessmentBoundary: Only identity, date, and duration metadata are used; linked papers, external commentary, and audience comments are excluded from assessment inputs.
